title: Ninety-session diagnosis scaling curve
description: A frozen size 1/2/4/8 workload curve over the immutable iteration-029 corpus to separate fixed session context from per-repository effort.

matrix.derivation: For each language and replicate: eight size-one bundles, four size-two bundles, two size-four bundles, and one size-eight bundle

primary_gate.correctness: At size eight, Parley hidden-repository success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: At size eight, Parley median reported total tokens per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: At size eight, Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: At size eight, Parley first-check repository success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict size-eight efficiency/reliability parity; two replicates make this directional, not a confirmation.

maintainability_gate.root_cause: All 64 Parley assignments across all four scales must modify the predeclared task/language defect file.
maintainability_gate.caller_compensation: A hidden-correct patch that does not modify the predeclared defect file fails root-cause quality and remains fully reported.

scaling_analysis.balanced_task_exposure: Every task appears exactly twice per language at every scale, so task composition is balanced across the curve.
reported_metrics: median and complete-distribution tokens per repository by language and scale
median and complete-distribution elapsed seconds per repository by language and scale
absolute and percentage Parley gaps to Python and Rust at every scale
ordinary least-squares fit of tokens per repository against reciprocal bundle size, reported descriptively
prompt, editable-source, read-only-context, edit-size, command, and file-action accounting by scale
scaling_analysis.interpretation: A falling absolute gap consistent with reciprocal bundle size supports fixed-overhead amortization; a stable or rising gap supports source/workflow cost. The fit is descriptive and cannot prove causality.

source_protocol.visible_files_per_assignment: Three editable source files and two read-only evidence files for every assigned repository.
source_protocol.public_examples: Protected by the checker and omitted from every agent prompt.
source_protocol.protected_files: Checker, source printer, configuration, prompt, provenance, public/hidden cases, and attempt log are never agent-readable and remain integrity-hashed.

interpretation_boundary: The task corpus, sources, evidence, cases, root-defect map, compiler, skill, and harness are exactly frozen from iteration 029.
Only bundle size, task grouping, and random order vary according to the preregistered seed.
The ninety fresh sessions map scaling behavior; they do not provide ten independent size-eight replicates.
Within each scale, every task appears exactly twice per language, but bundle composition may still affect model workflow.
No size or language cell may be selectively rerun, excluded, or tuned.
Root-cause location remains separate from hidden-output correctness.
secondary_analysis: Report all ninety sessions and every repository judgment, repair, token count, elapsed time, context/source/edit size, changed file, root-cause result, integrity result, command event, and file-change event.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by unrelated repository, independent session, and scale.
Report action counts and token gaps with and without repaired sessions only if repairs occur; never replace the complete primary result.
Compare the size-eight directional cells with preserved iteration 029 without pooling them into a post hoc gate.
feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155 with the exact 1,519-character skill. Iteration 030 changes no task, language, instruction, or harness behavior; it only varies frozen bundle size.
change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from iteration 029 output unless a signature recurs across unrelated repositories and independent sessions, then passes general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability review.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. Use the scale curve to choose the next broad corpus or confirmation, not to tune frozen tasks. No same-corpus syntax or instruction change is allowed.
